title: Read-Only Selector Discrimination Failure-Mechanism Audit Results

findings: No extra temperature is applied to the v0.33 selector output.
No batch/sample reduction occurs between selector_logit and per-sample utility_probability.
No detach/no_grad occurs between selector_logit and utility_probability.
No clamp is applied to utility_probability itself before threshold mapping.
The sigmoid is semantically consistent with BCEWithLogits training on the same selector_logit.
D1.limitation: This static finding does not prove absence of a runtime/learnability cause.

trace: u_target is derived from ground-truth-indexed candidate-versus-reference classifier probability difference
selector input contains q_t, q_v, c_tv and deterministic deficit/disagreement/risk transforms
selector input does not contain reference/candidate classifier logits, ground-truth class identity, delta_u, or an equivalent candidate-versus-reference utility signal
BCEWithLogits directly optimizes selector_logit against u_target with magnitude weighting
the same selector_logit is sigmoid-mapped to downstream utility_probability
findings: Objective-to-parameter wiring is intact: the same selector_logit used downstream is directly supervised by BCEWithLogits and enters total loss.
The inherited M2 gradient/movement finding is therefore consistent with source wiring.
However, target construction depends on information absent from the selector feature set.

This creates a structural information bottleneck: distinct/opposing counterfactual utility targets may be presented to the selector without the discriminative variables from which those targets were computed.
Under BCE supervision this is directionally capable of driving predictions toward a conditional mean near the neutral region even while gradients are nonzero and parameters move.
D2.anti_overclaim: The audit identifies a structurally plausible explanatory coupling defect; it is not sole causal proof and does not establish that any particular added feature or architecture will improve formal performance.

scientific_interpretation: The frozen source audit localizes the corrective design question to target-information availability/coupling rather than a downstream sigmoid/threshold implementation defect.
